patch_resolves_note: The official fix patch applied to the vulnerable source, but the fixed-side incremental rebuild failed in the patched workspace because the fallback /bin/arvo compile path could not run configured test binaries there. Stage 04 therefore used compile-fixed --fallback-image, which rebuilt the instrumented target inside the authoritative n132/arvo:10724-fix image. That clean fixed run still reached guard_read and satisfied the required operand-selection obligation, so the repair evidence is genuine even though the incremental fixed build path was unavailable.

root_cause_criterion.description: Inside the fallback-kern loop, the guard must test the mask field of the current loop slot info[idx] rather than the persistent buffer cursor slot selected by buffer->cur().mask.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable trace, guard_read records distinct operand addresses (mask_operand_ptr != loop_mask_ptr), so the protected guard executes with the wrong slot selected. In the fixed run, the same guard event executes genuinely and the two operand pointers are equal on every iteration.

nodes.description: At the fallback-kern guard, the preserved cursor index equals the initialized mask count, so the vulnerable expression buffer->cur().mask targets info[len], the first tail slot beyond the initialized glyph range.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records guard_read.cursor_idx=19 and guard_read.initialized_mask_count=19.

nodes.description: clear_positions() zeroes positions but leaves the buffer cursor untouched, so the stale cursor value entering positioning remains equal to the active glyph count.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records positions_cleared.cursor_idx=19 and positions_cleared.active_glyph_count=19.

edges.description: The same stale buffer cursor value preserved by clear_positions() reaches the fallback-kern guard unchanged and is the selector used by the vulnerable guard operand.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace carries cursor_idx=19 from positions_cleared directly into the first guard_read event.
